title: De-clutter for Christmas — donations for the Church Lench Christmas Fayre
body: Unwanted gifts, bric-a-brac, children's books and toys are welcome for a stall at the Church Lench Christmas Fayre on Saturday 28 November. Please leave donations inside All Saints' Church, Church Lench, between Monday 2 and Thursday 26 November.

image.alt: De-clutter for Christmas poster: donate unwanted gifts, bric-a-brac, children's books and toys for the Church Lench Christmas Fayre, left inside All Saints' Church, 2 to 26 November
